presentation.problem: Task-only qualification has no workbench tab selector; explicit-selection mode left its panel hidden. The MCP task also uses a separate tab from the initial adapter connection.
repairs: Automatic presentation applies only to the task-only qualification window; ordinary and qualification workbench windows retain explicit selection.
The fixture explicitly presents its actual task and verifies visibility in a fresh snapshot before native mouse, keyboard, clipboard and drag/drop checks.

mcp_event_ordering.problem: The pinned MCP relay processes command responses through asynchronous forwarding, while events are forwarded synchronously. Coalesced WebSocket frames can therefore deliver the default execution context before the preceding frame-tree reply, losing the context needed by page.read.
mcp_event_ordering.observed_red: An unmodified real Linux fixture hung on popup read; a low-perturbation stress run failed on the fourth popup even though the source wire ordered frame reply before context.
mcp_event_ordering.deterministic_reproduction: The actual pinned CDPRelay, ExtensionConnection, BrowserModel and ws Receiver/Sender receive coalesced frames; the previous configuration reorders events before the reply and the repaired configuration preserves the sequence.
mcp_event_ordering.repair: Only the MCP relay delegate opts out of synchronous WebSocket batch events; other WSServer delegates retain the upstream default.

hosted_red_history.failure: new native-input visibility precondition exposed the separate hidden task tab

hosted_result: The publishing commit Actions checks are authoritative; hosted success is not inferred from the local fixture.
diagnostics_retained: On macOS, the default /var temporary path alias was rejected by existing private-download realpath checks. The 8 focused tests passed with a canonical task-owned private TMPDIR; the security check was not weakened.

hosted_renderer_crash_followup.failure: Task renderer invalidation did not satisfy the original 5-second assertion.
hosted_renderer_crash_followup.diagnostics: Retain bounded Electron stderr and report only this fixture process tree, CoreDumping status, core pattern and remaining task pages on failure.
hosted_renderer_crash_followup.cause: Two intentionally crashed owned renderers were still CoreDumping=1; hosted systemd-coredump held their exit while collecting memory mappings. The task page had not received render-process-gone.
hosted_renderer_crash_followup.repair_scope: Set only the disposable qualifier process coredump_filter to zero before spawning its children; fork/exec inheritance excludes large memory mappings. No global core pattern, namespace, sandbox or product behavior change.

local_validation.observer_assertion_caveat: 41 PIDs each had at least one valid 00000000 read. No valid nonzero value was observed. Three PIDs subsequently returned empty/unavailable proc-file reads, which are not counted as zero or successful samples; no contemporaneous status was captured to establish the cause. The observer strict assertion failed and the original failure/raw evidence are retained. The actual full qualifier passed independently.
local_validation.limits: This owned Debian12/LinuxKit host uses core_pattern=core, not the GitHub runner systemd-coredump pipe. Hosted CI must verify that the original 5-second exit gate now passes under that collector.
